newsitem.title: USA: Richfood extends agreement with Camellia.
newsitem.headline: Richfood extends agreement with Camellia.

text.p: Richfood Holdings Inc said Wednesday that it has signed a two-year extension of its agreement with privately-held Camellia Food Stores Inc to provide procurement, distribution and transportation services to the grocery chain through April 2002.
Camellia operates about 44 retail grocery stores in Virginia, Delaware, Maryland, and North Carolina.
Richfood is a wholesale food distributor in the Mid-Atlantic region, which also runs sixteen retail food stores in metropolitan Baltimore.
